statement_map.email_excerpt: You wanted to find out why leads from your form were not receiving the autoresponder email.
We switched on the autoresponder option in your form settings, and you confirmed the email arrived after a test form submission.
We explained that emails can sometimes land in spam, so it would be good to verify your sender domain, which you can do in the email domain section of Settings.
Verify your sender domain in Settings (you mentioned you would do this the morning after our call).
